kv18.1:1.4: Nanu atthi Buddhavuttāni cetiyāni ārāmavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadānīti?
kv18.1:1.6: Hañci atthi Buddhavuttāni cetiyāni ārāmavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadāni, tena vata re vattabbe
kv18.1:2.4: Nanu Bhagavā Ḷumbiniyā jāto, Bodhiyā mūle abhisambuddho, Bārāṇasiyaṃ Bhagavatā Dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, Cāpāle cetiye āyusaṃkhāro ossaṭṭho, Kusinārāyaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto ti?
kv18.1:2.6: Hañci Bhagavā Ḷumbiniyā jāto, Bodhiyā mūle abhisambuddho, Bārāṇasiyaṃ Bhagavatā Dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, Cāpāle cetiye āyusaṃkhāro ossaṭṭho, Kusinārāyaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, tena vata re vattabbe
kv18.1:3.5: "Ekaṃ idāhaṃ Bhikkhave samayaṃ Ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi Subhagavane sālarājamūle ti,
kv18.1:3.6: ekaṃ idāhaṃ Bhikkhave samayaṃ Uruvelāyaṃ viharāmi Ajapālanigrodhe paṭhamābhisambuddho ti,
kv18.1:3.7: ekaṃ idāhaṃ Bhikkhave samayaṃ Rājagahe viharāmi Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe ti,
kv18.1:3.8: ekaṃ idāhaṃ Bhikkhave samayaṃ Sāvatthiyaṃ viharāmi Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme ti,
kv18.1:3.9: ekaṃ idāhaṃ Bhikkhave samayaṃ Vesāliyaṃ viharāmi Mahāvane kuṭāgārasālāyan ti."
kv18.1:3.12: Tena hi Buddho Bhagavā manussaloke aṭṭhāsīti. 4.
kv18.1:4.3: Nanu Bhagavā loke jāto loke sambuddho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokenāti?
kv18.1:4.5: Hañci Bhagavā loke jāto loke sambuddho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokena, no vata re vattabbe
